{{Quote|Coruscant has lovely sunsets.|[[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="TPM video game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Coruscant Prime''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].<ref name="CatCW" /> It was blue-white in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="RotS novel">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]''</ref>

At the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], following the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]], many [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] were emptied of their crews and sent into the star to be destroyed, loaded with the weapons of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders. This was in accordance with the [[Sekot accords|peace]] set out between [[Warmaster]] [[Nas Choka]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Following the end of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the body of [[Darth Krayt]] was sent into the sun to incinerate it and prevent the possibility of Krayt [[Dark transfer|returning]] from the [[Death/Legends|dead]] once more.<ref name="War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>
